name: TCP Port Conflict on Target Port 8080
description: A background rogue process binds 0.0.0.0:8080 preventing the web server from binding.
symptom: bind() to 0.0.0.0:8080 failed (98: Address already in use)
untrusted_logs:
[emerg] 1042#1042: bind() to 0.0.0.0:8080 failed (98: Address already in use)
[emerg] 1042#1042: still could not bind()
expected_root_cause: port 8080 is already occupied by another process
